Photorealistic high-end fashion portrait of a beautiful young adult woman standing beside a vintage red motorcycle on a narrow old European cobblestone street. She has long dark hair, realistic skin texture, and a confident relaxed expression. She wears a fitted dark green leather jacket, a black top, dark jeans, and brown lace-up boots. One hand rests lightly on the motorcycle while the other hangs naturally by her side. Her stance is balanced and believable, with clear foot placement on the cobblestones and realistic contact shadows.

The motorcycle is detailed with chrome parts, realistic tires, and glossy red paint. The street is lined with stone buildings, shop windows, and soft daylight. Camera is at standing eye level with a full-body vertical composition and clear depth through the street behind her. Natural body proportions, realistic clothing folds, believable perspective, subtle background blur, and rich but grounded cinematic color.
